baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ joins a perceiving human, his own inward self, and بصيرة as penetrating sight or proof.
baseline_models.mechanism: Perception in إنسان, hidden thought in نفس, and the heart's sight in بصيرة combine with على to place the human over or against his own interior as an already competent witness.

activation_trace.role: Perceiving something into awareness makes the human an active detector.
Inner thought and hidden intent supply the material being detected.
Inner sight, certainty, proof, and self-witness give بصيرة testimonial force.

changed_reading.before: A human being is generally aware of himself.
changed_reading.after: The human already stands as a penetrating witness against his own concealed thought and intent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: نَفْسِهِۦ and بَصِيرَةٌ carry compatible bodily images: life-blood for نفس and a visible blood-mark for بصيرة, with على locating evidence upon the self.
baseline_models.mechanism: The self is embodied life, not only inward mind. Its sustaining blood can leave a close visible trace, so the clause can picture evidence borne on the person's own body as a material counterpart to introspection.

activation_trace.role: Flowing blood as life's support makes نفس an embodied, vulnerable self.
A blood-trace close enough to see turns بصيرة into a material sign on that self.

changed_reading.before: The ayah concerns private introspective knowledge alone.
changed_reading.after: The embodied self can bear a visible residue of truth, giving inward testimony a somatic counterpart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Oath, deserved blame, acknowledgment, delivered report, and cast excuses form a procedural sequence around the focus. بصيرة becomes adverse first-person testimony: the self has already admitted what the report states, while excuses are coverings thrown over that admission.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned oath supplies a formal testimonial frame.
Deserved reproach gives the self-witness an accusatory function.
Acknowledgment sharpens inner knowledge into conceded evidence.
A delivered report supplies the external statement anticipated by self-testimony.
Casting something makes excuses active counterpleadings rather than missing knowledge.
Excuses as curtains make them attempted screens over existing evidence.

structural_cues: 75:1-2 opens with oaths and a blaming self; 75:13-15 places report, focus, and excuses in immediate succession.
The adversative بَلِ turns from being informed about deeds to the stronger fact of self-evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, blame, admission, report, and thrown excuses; I infer a juridical arrow toward self-testimony. A live alternative is nonprocedural moral conscience.

changed_reading.before: The human privately knows his condition.
changed_reading.after: The human is already an adverse witness in his own case, and excuses cover conceded evidence rather than cure ignorance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah depicts البصر as fixed or dazzled before calling the human بصيرة. The return separates vulnerable ocular sight from diagnostic inner sight: the organ can be seized while the self's disclosure remains operative.

activation_trace.role: A staring or fixed eye supplies a failure-state for ordinary vision.
Ocular seeing names the faculty that fails, contrasting with the focus word's inner sight.

structural_cues: 75:7 uses البصر; 75:14 returns with the feminine predicate بصيرة after the no-escape and reporting sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a seized eye and ocular seeing; I infer contrast with persistent self-disclosure. The alternative is intensification of one undivided faculty.

changed_reading.before: The person can look inward at himself.
changed_reading.after: Even when ordinary sight is overwhelmed, diagnostic self-sight continues to expose the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Thrown curtain-like excuses and the moving tongue are surface output, whereas gathering, reading, and clarification describe ordered disclosure. Anchored in بصيرة as proof and نفس as hidden content, the human becomes a readable self-record whose dispersed contents can be assembled and made clear.

activation_trace.role: Gathering scattered parts into a whole supplies the record's assembly.
Casting outward characterizes excuses as produced surface matter.
Curtain-like excuses obscure but do not alter the underlying record.
The tongue supplies the hurried output channel distinguished from evidence.
Reading and recitation turn assembled content into ordered disclosure.
Uncovering meaning by speech or sign supplies final clarification.

structural_cues: 75:14-19 runs from self-evidence and excuses through tongue movement, gathering, reading, following, and clarification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered operations and immediate sequence; I infer a model for making the self legible. A live alternative treats 75:16-19 as a separate address about recitation.

changed_reading.before: بصيرة is a static faculty of inward awareness.
changed_reading.after: The human self is also a record that can be gathered, read, and clarified despite hurried speech and excuses.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later-versus-immediate contrast relocates failure from cognition to preference. Love of what is advanced now causes the later reality to be left; the person's بصيرة can therefore be accurate while conduct suppresses its consequence.

activation_trace.role: What comes after supplies the deferred horizon self-sight should register.
Haste and advancement give the immediate object temporal pull.
Love fixed in the heart supplies force that can overrule insight.
Deliberate leaving supplies the result of temporal preference.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 follows disclosure with an explicit immediate-versus-later opposition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies love, haste, and abandonment; I infer a causal arrow from temporal desire to acting against known evidence. The alternative is that بصيرة appears only at judgment.

changed_reading.before: Wrong action reflects failure to recognize one's state.
changed_reading.after: The self may see accurately yet choose the immediate object it loves, making failure motivational rather than merely epistemic.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faces present the self outwardly: radiance, directed looking, and scowling make inward orientation visible, while certainty arises from a sign. بصيرة becomes a diagnostic presentation of the person, readable before verbal defense.

activation_trace.role: The face standing for the self makes appearance a presentation of identity.
Radiance supplies one involuntary visible state.
Directing eye or insight links facial orientation with inward perception.
A scowling face under aversion supplies the contrary visible state.
Certainty reached through an indication connects expression to recognized outcome.

structural_cues: 75:22-25 alternates radiant and scowling faces, then states what the latter anticipates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies faces, expressions, looking, and sign-based certainty; I infer involuntary testimony. The alternative is that these are outcomes, not evidence mechanisms.

changed_reading.before: Self-testimony remains concealed inside the person.
changed_reading.after: The self also testifies by becoming legible in its face, orientation, and involuntary expression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arrival at a bodily limit, breath at the clavicular region, separation, wrapping limbs, compelled driving, and lost life form a physiological chain. This activates the breath and blood branches of نفس and the blood-mark branch of بصيرة: the dying body visibly performs its condition.

activation_trace.role: Reaching an endpoint supplies the terminal bodily threshold.
The clavicular place where breath rises connects healing with departing life-breath.
Separation supplies the recognized break from present life.
One thing wrapping another supplies visible bodily constriction.
Driving supplies compelled direction after bodily control fails.
Departure of force and life names the completed condition the body displays.

structural_cues: 75:26-30 moves from the throat or collarbone region through separation, wrapped legs, and being driven.
The ت ر ق occurrence in 75:26 is structural only because the packet supplies no branch inventory for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the bodily sequence and images of rising breath, wrapping, and lost life; I infer that these signs make the body a witness. The alternative is a chronological death scene with no backward activation.

changed_reading.before: The self's witness is chiefly moral and cognitive.
changed_reading.after: At death, breath, limbs, and loss of force turn the body itself into self-disclosing testimony.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth realized in action and worship are negated; denial, turning away, return to close people, and swagger are enacted. Conduct and bearing become a second channel of بصيرة, disclosing allegiance even when speech denies it.

activation_trace.role: Truth realized in deed establishes action as a test of conviction.
Obligatory worship supplies the concrete practice withheld.
Contradiction of truth supplies explicit denial.
Turning away converts denial into directional conduct.
The close group supplies the social audience for the posture.
Swagger through extended posture makes inward refusal visible.

structural_cues: 75:31-33 pairs two negated acts with contrary acts, then ends on a socially displayed bodily manner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies action pairs and swaggering return; I infer that posture testifies against denial. The alternative is that deeds are only judged items, not a witness mode.

changed_reading.before: The human testifies through inward cognition.
changed_reading.after: Omissions, turns, affiliations, and bodily bearing also testify, visibly refuting denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: A remaining trace, seminal fluid from which form is measured, coagulated blood, measured creation, completion, transformation, and pairing make the present self the outcome of ordered material history. Anchored in على نفسه and the blood-trace branch of بصيرة, the body becomes an archive of origin and dependence.

activation_trace.role: Completion and proportion supply the finished form retaining formative history.
A remaining trace activates evidence preserved rather than abandoned.
A drop of fluid including semen supplies the minimal material beginning.
Semen from which form is measured links origin with determination.
Coagulated blood supplies an intermediate stage and reconnects to the focus's blood-trace.
Measuring and proportioning supply the formative operation.
Transformation into a state supplies transition to differentiated form.
A counterpart joined to its pair supplies relational differentiation.

structural_cues: 75:36 asks whether the human is left without consequence; 75:37-40 answers through staged origin, formation, differentiation, and renewed life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered stages and measured formation; I infer that the resulting body retains them as evidence. The alternative is an external creation argument with no bodily archive.

changed_reading.before: The self knows a history of chosen deeds.
changed_reading.after: The self also embodies a pre-volitional history of measured formation that evidences origin, dependence, and answerability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the specialized little-human image in the pupil folds observer into observed. It remains anchored in إنسان and بصيرة in the focus itself. Render it only as a self-reflexive visual image, not as the lexical definition of إنسان here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same clause contains إنسان and بصيرة, allowing a human figure inside the seeing eye to stage recursive self-observation.

activation_trace.role: The small human image in the pupil supplies an observer-within-vision image.
Eye-seeing supplies the optical surface in which that image appears.
Inner sight turns optical reflection into a contained model of self-witness.

changed_reading.before: A stable subject looks at an independent inner object.
changed_reading.after: The observing human is recursively contained in his own field of sight, making witness and witnessed inseparable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This branch-distant model combines بصيرة as armor or a joined hide-edge with excuses as curtains. It remains anchored in the predicate laid upon the self and the immediately following cast excuses. Render it as a material analogy for defensive self-presentation, not a claim that بصيرة means excuse or curtain.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ permits a protective object laid on the self, while 75:15 supplies cast curtain-like excuses.

activation_trace.role: The very thing itself provides the identity upon which a layer is mounted.
Shining shield or armor supplies a hard protective model for بصيرة.
A thick sewn joint supplies the construction of a covering surface.
Casting an object supplies the act of deploying a defense.
Curtain-like excuses supply the soft screen paired with armor.

changed_reading.before: بصيرة only penetrates and exposes the self.
changed_reading.after: The lexical field can picture self-armoring: excuses cover the person, yet deploying them displays the truth they hide.

strongest_changes: Oath, blame, report, admission, and excuses strengthen inner awareness into juridical self-testimony.
The dazzled ocular بصر distinguishes vulnerable eye-sight from persistent diagnostic بصيرة.
Gathering, reading, and clarification make the self a recoverable record that hurried speech cannot rewrite.
Love of the immediate shows that accurate self-sight may be motivationally overridden rather than absent.
Death and creation extend self-witness into the body as physiological sign and material archive.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet moved the focus triad of human, self, and sight through oath, report, speech-processing, temporal desire, facial expression, dying physiology, enacted denial, and measured formation, supporting several coexisting mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The readable-record model depends on treating 75:16-19 as an activator rather than a separate address.
The blood-trace, pupil, armor, and joined-edge branches remain too distant for unqualified prose.
Facial and bodily signs may be intended testimony or only contextually resonant extensions of an inward witness.
